((volume.restrict (Icc (-R) R)).prod
  (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => (volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Icc (-R) R))))
proof:
intro k R
rw [Measure.prod_restrict]
congr 1
exact (Measure.restrict_pi_pi (fun _ : Fin k => (volume : Measure ℝ))
  (fun _ => Icc (-R) R)).symm
